hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880123 (13 public Modern Electric sites list 50-amp, 17 list 30-amp), https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sinnemahoning-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880123, read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 'The 35-site campground', with sites taking 'camping equipment from tents to large recreational vehicles and motor homes'. The booking site lists 30 Modern Electric drive-in sites and 2 walk-to sites in the Main Loop. Listed max vehicle lengths: 20 ft at ten sites, 30-45 ft at ten, 55-75 ft at nine; one pull-through (034).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sinnemahoning-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880123 (site list and each site's details page) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: The booking page lists the nearest camp store (under a mile) and laundromat (over 10 miles) as outside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/sinnemahoning-state-park/stay ('a sanitary dump station and modern restroom with flush toilets and showers') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880123 ('Nearest Camp Store Outside The Campground', 'Nearest Laundromat Outside Of Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'Campsites can be reserved up to 11 months in advance and up to noon on the day of arrival.'

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window and the noon day-of-arrival cutoff (stated on this park's DCNR page); season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric, 32 campsites to 75 ft with one pull-through, showers, flush toilets, dump, no camp store or laundry in the campground. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, min/max stay, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
